title: SC 模块闭环：全 PASS 下的 336 行重复发射点、148 臂按副本归因与全脏写缓冲开放候选
status: module execution and coverage triage complete; one public-observation gap remains open
scope: 独立 Sc DUT 的 23 个功能点与 51 个选测用例；不证明完整 BPU 或完整 FTQ

uncovered_lines.semantic: Each field assignment is emitted three times. The two uncovered sites are inner ~hit arms nested under an outer if (hit); hit && ~hit is unsatisfiable. The third site, inside the else of if (hit), is covered.
uncovered_lines.grouping: 2 blocks x 4 entries x 9 or 33 fields; not 336 functions

threshold_clamp_proof.per_beat_delta: at most 15 from the 4-bit inc/dec aggregate
threshold_clamp_proof.kind: bounded arithmetic and outer-guard proof, not whole-design formal

uncovered_branches.weight_and_priority_copies: Per-row/per-way instances of the same SignedSaturateCounter or selection; behavior is verified on the exercised instances by BPU-SC-005/007/008/012/013/014/019. This is a per-copy classification, not a claim that every instance was exercised.

write_buffer_full_victim.signal: victim = replacerWay_0 when all four buffer entries are dirty
write_buffer_full_victim.source_contract: A miss on a full row overwrites a dirty victim
write_buffer_full_victim.why_open: overwrite/full are not top-level Sc ports; the training agent serializes each batch to idle, so coexistence of four pending writes was not established
write_buffer_full_victim.disposition: not PASS, not claimed unreachable; needs a read-only monitor or an explicit contract exclusion

no_new_case_reason: No missing statistical, threshold, bias, eligibility or pipeline case was found in the existing 23 points.
The 336 lines are duplicate emission sites, with the reachable copy covered.
The remaining arms are saturation endpoints and priority-matrix cells already verified on exercised copies.
The only unobserved semantic path lacks public observation; inventing bank/set sweeps or internal writes is not acceptable evidence.
false_positive_false_negative_checks: All 51 PASS and 28/28 groups do not close the module; an all-dirty write-buffer path remains unobserved.
Guard classification uses exact native producer/span association for the current epoch, not line-text similarity.
The threshold endpoints are proven unreachable by accepted range and per-beat delta, not by 'we did not reach them'.
No XFAIL was added and no existing verdict was relaxed.
No RTL, DUT or system SDK change.
constraints: The selected run does not replace the retained full regression (24776 PASS / 88 FAIL / 3 XFAIL).
No internal signal writes and no physical bank/set sweep.
Full FTQ lifetime and composed BPU arbitration remain outside the module scope.
